canonicalization.completeness_proof: C(S) = A_T(S) for the minimising T, so S = A_T^{-1}(C(S)); equal canonical forms exhibit an explicit group element carrying one sequence to the other
canonicalization.definition: C(S) = lex-min over ordered independent triples T from supp(S) of the ascending expansion of A_T(S), where A_T is the unique g in GL(3,5) with g(T) = (e1,e2,e3)
canonicalization.invariance_proof: triples of g(S) are exactly the g-images of triples of S and A_{gT} = A_T o g^{-1}, so A_{gT}(gS) = A_T(S): the candidate sets coincide

prior_art.rank_2_solved: Zhong 2025, On the inverse problem of k-th Davenport constants for groups of rank 2, Combinatorica

proved.P1: every zero-sum of a witness has length >= 7 (the complement of a zero-sum of length L is zero-sum-free, so 19-L <= D(C_5^3)-1 = 12)
proved.P2: every zero-sum has length <= 13 = D(C_5^3) (a zero-sum of length >=14 contains one inside any 13 of its elements, leaving a second disjoint zero-sum)
proved.P3: the total sum of a witness is nonzero (immediate from P2 since 19 > 13)
proved.P4: maximum multiplicity <= 4 (five copies sum to zero, length 5 < 7)
